checkerboard_points — CALIB checkerboard op

• Data kinds: none → keypoints (an op determined by its arguments alone — it takes no image or data input)

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.checkerboard_points(pattern_size, square_size) (to call the implementation directly, import calib_lm; calib_lm.checkerboard_points(pattern_size, square_size); from the registry, opscalib.get("checkerboard_points"))

• GPU: none (CPU reference implementation only)

Usage

Returns the board coordinates (x, y) of the inner corners of a checkerboard in row-major order (keypoints).

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

Board coordinates (x, y) of the inner corners of a checkerboard with pattern_size = (cols, rows) inner corners and squares of square_size (mm), row-major: index r·cols + c is (c·square, r·square). The first corner is the origin (OpenCV's convention for findChessboardCorners). The board has (cols + 1) x (rows + 1) squares.

Raises ValueError: cols・rows が 2 未満・整数でない、square_size が正でない。
